init.title: Polling
init.description: The Miele consumer cloud is rate-limited and throws intermittent errors, so how often to poll is a trade-off. Adaptive polling uses the interval below when the cabinet is idle, drops to 10 s for a minute after you change something or while a door is open, and backs off automatically while the cloud is failing.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll when nothing is happening. 15-900 seconds; the default is 60.
data_description.adaptive: When off, the interval above is used at all times.

set_cooling_value.name: Set cooling value
set_cooling_value.description: Writes a raw value to a unit-wide /Cooling node on the appliance (PUT /Cooling/{name}). An escape hatch for nodes this integration has no entity for; the appliance's reply is returned so you can discover what a node accepts.

name.name: Node name
name.description: The /Cooling node to write, e.g. Sabbath, AirFilter, HumidityControl. Letters and digits only, starting with a letter.

value.name: Value
value.description: The integer to write. Most toggles use 1 for on and 2 for off; temperatures are centi-degrees (1200 = 12 °C).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The wine cabinet to write to. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Alternative to Device: the config entry to write to. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

set_zone_value.name: Set zone value
set_zone_value.description: Writes a raw value to a per-zone /Cooling node on the appliance (PUT /Cooling/{zone}/{name}), e.g. TargetTemp or PresentationLightIntensity. The appliance's reply is returned.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone key as reported by the API: 1, 2, ... Digits only.

name.name: Node name
name.description: The /Cooling/{zone} node to write, e.g. TargetTemp, PresentationLightIntensity. Letters and digits only, starting with a letter.

value.name: Value
value.description: The integer to write. Temperatures are centi-degrees (1200 = 12 °C); levels are raw integers inside the node's own Min/Max.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The wine cabinet to write to. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Alternative to Device: the config entry to write to. Can be left empty when only one is set up.
